en.sayed-ali-raza: O creatures of Allāh! I advise you to keep away from this world
which is (shortly) to leave you even though you do not like its departure, and which would make your bodies old even though you would like to keep them fresh.
Your example and its example is like the travellers who travel some distance and then as though they traverse it quickly or they aimed at a sign and reached it at once.
How short is the distance to the aim if one heads towards it and reaches it.
And how short is the stage of one who has only a day which he cannot exceed while a swift driver is driving him in this world till he departs from it.
